## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% per-trade risk cap and ITM-2 entry premium.
2. **Sample bias:** Sample = all trading days 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18 (18 months). Selection method = chronological, non-overlapping. Overfit risk = low; veto is structural and parameter-free (uses existing market_structure.classify_trend).
3. **Out-of-sample:** OOS test on 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q1 shows edge_capture 780, Sharpe 4.728, final_score 3,688 — all in-sample and OOS consistent (no significant decay).
4. **Real-fills:** Real-fills validated on top 3 J days (all winners kept). Full OPRA real-fills A/B shows P&L increase from +7,555 to +8,138 (+$583) with no anchor regression.
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: max drawdown −2,273 (flat vs baseline).
   - Blow-up scenario: None observed; veto only removes trades, never adds risk.
   - Edge case: If market structure misclassifies due to noisy 5m bars, veto may incorrectly block a valid bear setup (rare, mitigated by confirmation required).
6. **Concentration:** Not explicitly disclosed in available data; top-5 days concentration unknown -- requires additional Stage-1 backtest if needed for position sizing.
